name: GMK Just Beachy
heroImageAlt: Six CYL-profile keycaps in a two-row cluster, rendered in a warm-grey line stroke with a coral wash across the two center alpha caps, evoking the coastal-toned GMK CYL Just Beachy colorway, with a small warm-bronze theme dot in the upper right margin.
description: GMK Just Beachy — a Cherry-profile keycap set in GMK's CYL mold family, opening simultaneously across five vendors on five regions: Keebz N Cables (Oceania), Divinikey (US), Prototypist (UK), KBDfans (China), and Unikeys (Canada). Running August 18–September 22, 2026; base kit pricing and full kitting list not yet announced.
